claims.behavior: Exact staged 1–500 integer control; raw legacy integers retained until Options Apply. Saved changes reach the corresponding owned QueueRunner work pool, while active counts survive lowering/growth. Pending jobs own no permits; completion/error/cancellation/owner-close cleanup releases only its own category permit. Watcher checks and files run independently. Monotonic queue allocation and owner-qualified seed writes prevent deleted-worker callbacks affecting successors.
limits: Authored Rust/native/downloader tests await hosted CI; no local Cargo builds, Rust tests or mutation runs.
